    Dune: Awakening Deep Desert Map & Loot Tables

    The Deep Desert Companion is your all-in-one solution for thriving in the Deep Desert. It contains a Deep Desert Map (with all key POIs), rotating Deep Desert loot tables and PVE guides for Testing Stations & Wrecks. Updated shortly after the reset each week.

    Deep Desert Map
    POI Loot Tables

    Deep Desert Map

    • Standard
    • Single Player

    Updated for: 27th October > 3rd November

    In the PVP instance of the Deep Desert, mining yields and spice harvesting is increased by 250%.

    NEW! Detailed Maps: Try switching the map view from Normal to Detailed for more filters (including crashed ships and all resources) and much more granular resource density on zoom.
